3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: As we approached, a pair of soldiers, flanked on either side of the entrance, greeted us with a formal salute.

5.speaker: Narrator
5.text: The crisp morning air filled my lungs as I crossed the palace courtyard with Hugo.
5.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_OnCouncil"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn02_MalenyevistPropaganda_Ban"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_OnCouncil"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn02_MalenyevistPropaganda_Ban"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_OnCouncil"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn02_MalenyevistPropaganda_Ban"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_OnCouncil"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn02_MalenyevistPropaganda_Ban"] == false) == false)

10.speaker: Player_Romus
10.text: "Shh! I want to see what happens."

11.speaker: Player_Romus
11.text: "As king, I mustn't indulge in gambling, whether with money or life."

12.speaker: Player_Romus
12.text: "I don't have time for this. Would you kindly get their attention?"

14.speaker: Player_Romus
14.text: "Agreed. There are substantial benefits to strengthening ties between us."

15.speaker: Player_Romus
15.text: "Forging a personal relationship is inconsequential. What matters most is his ability to perform his duties."

16.speaker: Player_Romus
16.text: "I'm not sure what there is to be gained, but I am willing to keep an open mind."

17.speaker: Player_Romus
17.text: "Doubtful. I've never formed close relationships with my security detail in the past."

18.speaker: Hugo Toras
18.text: "More than you know. I believe the Golden Guard possesses an untapped potential that would prove quite advantageous should the need arise."

19.speaker: Hugo Toras
19.text: "Excellent. Even if nothing comes of it, your willingness to engage in meaningful conversation is encouraging."

20.speaker: Hugo Toras
20.text: "I can tell you firsthand that he's fully capable of executing them with utmost proficiency."

21.speaker: Hugo Toras
21.text: "Your ascension to the throne calls for a strengthening of all associations."

22.speaker: Narrator
22.text: I was headed to a long-overdue meeting with Titus regarding the Golden Guard, and my uncle had insisted on accompanying me.

23.speaker: Hugo Toras
23.text: "I'm glad you've arranged a formal meeting with Captain Gordion. There's much to be gained in fostering a robust relationship."

24.speaker: Hugo Toras
24.text: "But I'm getting ahead of myself. Captain Gordion can tell you more."

25.speaker: Hugo Toras
25.text: "In this case, building trust with the Golden Guard would benefit palace security as well as your own personal well-being."

26.speaker: Narrator
26.text: It wasn't long before we'd crossed the courtyard and reached the armory, which also served the Golden Guard's headquarters.

27.speaker: Narrator
27.text: Both seemed unsure how to react.

30.speaker: Player_Romus
30.text: "Don't worry, I'm granting you permission to touch me."

32.speaker: Narrator
32.text: Letting down their guard, literally and figuratively, they both reached out and gave me a high-five.

35.speaker: Narrator
35.text: They looked at one another for confirmation before doing as instructed.

36.speaker: Narrator
36.text: They hesitated at first before they each gave me a high-five.

37.speaker: Narrator
37.text: That made them smile before giving me a high-five.

38.speaker: Player_Romus
38.text: "Excellent! You both have promising futures ahead of you."

40.speaker: Hugo Toras
40.text: "I think it's best if we move on."

41.speaker: Narrator
41.text: I lowered my outstretched palm just as Hugo stepped between me and the guards.

42.speaker: Player_Romus
42.text: "I'll leave when I say I'm ready."

44.speaker: Player_Romus
44.text: "You're no fun... But yes. Let us continue onward."

45.speaker: Narrator
45.text: I let a moment of silence fall between us.

49.speaker: Narrator
49.text: Hugo and I continued on our way.

50.speaker: Narrator
50.text: Upon entering the armory, I found myself surrounded by a collection of old weaponry and armor on display. The polished shields and rusted swords appeared frozen in time.

51.speaker: Narrator
51.text: We eventually reached a training facility where we found Captain Gordion in boxing gloves sparring with another Golden Guardsman.

52.speaker: Titus Gordion
52.text: "You're wasting too much energy running around the ring. Next time--"

53.speaker: Hugo Toras
53.text: "My money is on Captain Gordion. What do you say, 50 guilder?"

60.speaker: Narrator
60.text: The captain turned to face us. He and his opponent bowed their heads when they saw me.

61.speaker: Titus Gordion
61.text: "Forgive me, Your Majesty. I didn't see you there. You're earlier than I expected."

62.speaker: Player_Romus
62.text: "If anything, I should be the one apologizing for interrupting you."

63.speaker: Player_Romus
63.text: "It's not your fault. I arrived sooner than anticipated."

64.speaker: Player_Romus
64.text: "I'm surprised you were unaware of your king's whereabouts, considering that falls within your jurisdiction."

65.speaker: Narrator
65.text: The two men circled each other for a while before they started swinging. Three rounds later, the Captain had his opponent on the ropes.

66.speaker: Player_Romus
66.text: "No, *my* money is on Captain Gordion. You take the other man."

67.speaker: Hugo Toras
67.text: "Very well. Let the best man win!"

68.speaker: Hugo Toras
68.text: "It appears Captain Gordion has emerged victorious."

69.speaker: Player_Romus
69.text: "Yes, it does. I would pay you now, but I never carry cash."

70.speaker: Player_Romus
70.text: "You know I'm not paying you, right?"

71.speaker: Player_Romus
71.text: "What do you think... should I hop in the ring? I bet I could take him."

72.speaker: Player_Romus
72.text: "It certainly does. Looks like I owe you."

73.speaker: Hugo Toras
73.text: "One of the many perks of being king! I'll come to collect at a later date."

75.speaker: Hugo Toras
75.text: "That's not sportsmanlike at all. But very well, Your Majesty."

76.speaker: Hugo Toras
76.text: "As Grand Vizier to the king, I would be remiss to endorse such a course of action."

77.speaker: Narrator
77.text: I watched as Captain Gordion helped the other man to his feet.

78.speaker: Titus Gordion
78.text: "Your Majesty! Many apologies. I didn't see you there. You're earlier than I expected."

79.speaker: Player_Romus
79.text: "Your lack of observation is disappointing. My early arrival shouldn't be unexpected."

80.speaker: Player_Romus
80.text: "I'm here before my usual time. I should be the one apologizing."

81.speaker: Player_Romus
81.text: "Your oversight is evident. My punctuality shouldn't be a surprise."

82.speaker: Player_Romus
82.text: "No need to apologize. Just like in the ring, timing can be a challenge."

84.speaker: Titus Gordion
84.text: "No need, but I appreciate the sentiment."

85.speaker: Titus Gordion
85.text: "Yes, Your Majesty. It won't happen again."

87.speaker: Player_Romus
87.text: "Well, I don't have all day. Let us retire so we may discuss the nature of my visit."

88.speaker: Player_Romus
88.text: "I must say, that's quite the right hook you got there."

89.speaker: Player_Romus
89.text: "Alright, enough chit-chat. Let's get out of here and talk somewhere more private."

90.speaker: Player_Romus
90.text: "In any case, let us take our leave. We have much to discuss."

94.speaker: Titus Gordion
94.text: "If you'll follow me, we can delve into the matter you've here to address."

96.speaker: Narrator
96.text: The two men circle each other for a while before exchanging swings. Three rounds later, the Captain had Hugo's guy in a tight spot.

97.speaker: Hugo Toras
97.text: "And Titus has emerged victoriously. Looks like I owe you."

98.speaker: Player_Romus
98.text: "Guess I have a knack for picking winners."

99.speaker: Player_Romus
99.text: "Oh, don't worry about it. It was a lighthearted wager."

100.speaker: Player_Romus
100.text: "We should have them go another round. What do you say? Raise the bet? Double or nothing?"

102.speaker: Hugo Toras
102.text: "No doubt a useful skill to possess."

103.speaker: Hugo Toras
103.text: "Certainly -- as soon as we've concluded this meeting."

105.speaker: Hugo Toras
105.text: "Tempting, but no thanks. I've already lost once today. I don't need a repeat."

106.speaker: Titus Gordion
106.text: "No need, but I appreciate the sentiment. I was just showing our newest recruit a thing or two in the ring."

107.speaker: Titus Gordion
107.text: "My men have eyes on you at all times, Your Majesty. In the event of an emergency, I would have been contacted at once."

109.speaker: Titus Gordion
109.text: "Well, it's great to have you here, regardless of when you arrived."

110.speaker: Player_Romus
110.text: "In any event, we should get moving. We have plenty to talk about."

112.speaker: Player_Romus
112.text: "I must say, that's quite the right hook you got there."

114.speaker: Narrator
114.text: Although the other fighter managed to land a few hits, the match concluded with Captain Gordion prevailing, thanks to a powerful punch to his opponent's jaw.

127.speaker: Player_Romus
127.text: "Thanks, but your counsel is no longer required. I'd like to speak to the captain alone."

128.speaker: Player_Romus
128.text: "I believe the kind of trust you want me to build with the Golden Guard can only be established by meeting Titus one-on-one."

129.speaker: Narrator
129.text: Captain Gordion removed his boxing gloves as he headed toward an entrance to another wing of the armory.

130.speaker: Player_Romus
130.text: "Take a tour of the armory or find some other means to entertain yourself."

132.speaker: Player_Romus
132.text: "You can wait around until my business is complete, but you're welcome to take your leave."

134.speaker: Hugo Toras
134.text: "I see. Well, if that is your wish, I will stay where I am."

137.speaker: Hugo Toras
137.text: "If you want to ensure the good captain is on our side, then yes. We 'must.'"

138.speaker: Narrator
138.text: Hugo seemed to force a smile before bowing his head and turning away.

142.speaker: Narrator
142.text: Hugo and I caught up to Titus as he stepped inside the building.

144.speaker: Narrator
144.text: Upon entering, we were once again enveloped by an array of antiquated weaponry and armor.

145.speaker: Player_Romus
145.text: "Quite the arsenal you've got here, Captain."

146.speaker: Player_Romus
146.text: "I like what you've done with the place."

147.speaker: Player_Romus
147.text: "I've often found that focusing too much on memorializing the past can impede progress."

148.speaker: Player_Romus
148.text: "Bows and arrows? Duchess Azaro wasn't kidding when she said our military needed upgrading."

150.speaker: Hugo Toras
150.text: "I'm pleased you take such an interest in preserving Rizia's history."

152.speaker: Narrator
152.text: That drew a laugh from my uncle, while the captain simply smiled patiently.

153.speaker: Titus Gordion
153.text: "You're more than welcome to visit anytime -- not that you need an invitation. In any case..."

154.speaker: Titus Gordion
154.text: "True, though I personally believe that such memorials can offer inspiration. Especially during times of great difficulty."

155.speaker: Titus Gordion
155.text: "Believe me, this is just a fraction of what the palace has got tucked away."

156.speaker: Titus Gordion
156.text: "Well, we still have several trebuchets on standby in case we need to fling cows at the enemy."

157.speaker: Titus Gordion
157.text: "I brought most of this out of storage soon after I took command. A considerable portion of what you see was in bad shape and required extensive refurbishment."

158.speaker: Hugo Toras
158.text: "Ha! As long as we get the green light from animal rights activists."

160.speaker: Titus Gordion
160.text: "If you desire, I'd be honored to provide you with the background and history of anything here."

163.speaker: Player_Romus
163.text: "No, thank you. I always found history lessons boring."

164.speaker: Player_Romus
164.text: "Tempted as I am, time is of the essence."

165.speaker: Titus Gordion
165.text: "Certainly. What would you like to hear about first?"

167.speaker: Titus Gordion
167.text: "Excellent. Where would you like to start?"

168.speaker: Titus Gordion
168.text: "Understandable. The study of history isn't to everyone's liking."

170.speaker: Player_Romus
170.text: "Why don't you tell me about that sword?"

171.speaker: Player_Romus
171.text: "Tell me about that impressive suit of armor."

172.speaker: Player_Romus
172.text: "Enough history. I'm ready to move on."

173.speaker: Player_Romus
173.text: "I'm curious to know about... whatever *that* is."

176.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
176.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_SecurityTitus_ArmorHistory"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_SecurityTitus_SwordHistory"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_SecurityTitus_IronMaidenHistory"] == true) == false

190.speaker: Titus Gordion
190.text: "You'll be happy to know it hasn't been used in quite some time."

191.speaker: Titus Gordion
191.text: "Enhanced interrogation methods have come a long way in the past century. No need for metal spikes unless you're a traditionalist."

194.speaker: Titus Gordion
194.text: "That would be 'Saint Mercy,' our aptly named iron maiden -- a torture device from a bygone era. It was last used on suspected spies during the War of Rizian Succession."

195.speaker: Titus Gordion
195.text: "'Terador's Fury.' Its notoriety spans back several hundred years, just after the Empire of Valgos seized Pales from Rizia."

196.speaker: Titus Gordion
196.text: "Although we lost our most important port, we managed to keep our enemy from making further inroads into the kingdom at the Battle of Terador."

197.speaker: Titus Gordion
197.text: "After securing power in Monqiz, his dynasty maintained a stronghold over the city-state throughout the Markian era."

198.speaker: Hugo Toras
198.text: "Legend has it, this sword took off the head of the Valgos army's top general."

199.speaker: Player_Romus
199.text: "It's considered bad luck to mention severed heads in the presence of a king."

201.speaker: Titus Gordion
201.text: "That would be the armor of King Henricus Toras, the ancestor from whom all members of your house are descended."

202.speaker: Player_Romus
202.text: "But it wasn't enough to prevent Pales being taken from Rizia. That's what keeps me awake at night."

203.speaker: Titus Gordion
203.text: "But I'm sure you knew that already."

204.speaker: Hugo Toras
204.text: "Yes. However, if I may be so bold, Your Majesty, there are valuable lessons to be learned from looking to Rizia's past -- lessons that could address present-day challenges, should they arise."

205.speaker: Player_Romus
205.text: "If you both think it's that important, then go ahead, Captain."

206.speaker: Player_Romus
206.text: "Fine, fine... You've convinced me. Let's hear it."

207.speaker: Player_Romus
207.text: "What part of 'I have other priorities' do you not understand?"

208.speaker: Player_Romus
208.text: "I agree with you, Uncle. However, it isn't something I'm interested in delving into at the moment."

209.speaker: Hugo Toras
209.text: "Very well. I'll refrain from mentioning it further."

210.speaker: Hugo Toras
210.text: "Got it. I won't bring it up again."

212.speaker: Titus Gordion
212.text: "Certainly. Where would you like to start?"

214.speaker: Hugo Toras
214.text: "If I may be so bold, Your Majesty, there are valuable lessons to be learned from looking to Rizia's past -- lessons that could address present-day challenges, should they arise."

215.speaker: Player_Romus
215.text: "I already said I'm not interested. Nor did I ask for your advice."

217.speaker: Narrator
217.text: We continued onward until we reached Captain Gordion's office on the far side of the hall. It too was adorned with a large collection of war memorabilia.

218.speaker: Narrator
218.text: Captain Gordion gestured to a sitting area.

220.speaker: Narrator
220.text: Uncle Hugo sat on a sofa that looked to have been plucked from the 19th century.

223.speaker: Narrator
223.text: Hugo, seeming suddenly self-aware of being the only one sitting, promptly stood back up.

224.speaker: Player_Romus
224.text: "Drinking on the job? You should both be ashamed of yourselves."

225.speaker: Player_Romus
225.text: "The fact that you would consider drinking on the job raises questions about your professionalism, Titus."

226.speaker: Player_Romus
226.text: "Just a little bit. I've got to stay sharp for the rest of the day's activities."

227.speaker: Player_Romus
227.text: "You had me at 'fortified'. Regular wine's for weaklings."
227.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_SecurityTitus_HugoPresent"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_SoberKing"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_Monqiz_PartyPrince"] == true)

228.speaker: Titus Gordion
228.text: "Would you care for some fortified wine? It's an exceptional vintage dating back to 1893. From Rizia's very own Cantuavo vineyards."

229.speaker: Narrator
229.text: The captain took out a bottle of wine from a cabinet.

230.speaker: Player_Romus
230.text: "Thanks, but no thanks. I only drink wine from 1892."

231.speaker: Titus Gordion
231.text: "So to what do I owe the pleasure of your company today?"

232.speaker: Narrator
232.text: Captain Gordion put the bottle away.

236.speaker: Titus Gordion
236.text: "Sorry. I'm afraid I'm fresh out of wine from that year."

237.speaker: Hugo Toras
237.text: "I believe His Majesty was joking. But perhaps we should all abstain after all."

238.speaker: Narrator
238.text: Captain Gordion uncorked the bottle and poured us each a glass. We briefly toasted and took a sip.

241.speaker: Narrator
241.text: After putting it away, he settled in a chair across from me.
241.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_SecurityTitus_Sit"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_SoberKing"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.PersonalValues_FellOffWagon"] == false) == false)

242.speaker: Narrator
242.text: After putting it away, he stood facing me.
242.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_SecurityTitus_Sit"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_SoberKing"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.PersonalValues_FellOffWagon"] == false) == false)

246.speaker: Player_Romus
246.text: "As the King of Rizia, I have many enemies. I wanted to make sure you're not one of them."

247.speaker: Player_Romus
247.text: "I'm looking to develop a clearer understanding of the individuals comprising my security detail, particularly the man who's leading them."

248.speaker: Player_Romus
248.text: "I wanted to get away from my council and speak to a real commoner. Your perspectives are always so refreshing."

249.speaker: Player_Romus
249.text: "My uncle suggested I get to know you better, believing that building a personal relationship beyond our professional one would be highly beneficial."

250.speaker: Titus Gordion
250.text: "Well, I'm more than happy to tell you about myself, though you might find hearing about the Golden Guard more interesting."

251.speaker: Titus Gordion
251.text: "I don't see why not. What would you like to know?"

252.speaker: Titus Gordion
252.text: "It's been quite some time since I was among the common people, Your Majesty."

253.speaker: Titus Gordion
253.text: "Certainly not, Your Majesty. Please, ask me anything."

254.speaker: Player_Romus
254.text: "Why don't you tell me more about yourself?"

255.speaker: Player_Romus
255.text: "Let's hear more about the Golden Guard."

265.speaker: Titus Gordion
265.text: "Well, I was born and raised in Porte Drazon. My father was in the military while my mother took care of me and my siblings."

266.speaker: Titus Gordion
266.text: "I'd be honored. As you already know, each guardsman stationed in this palace and across Rizia Imperii has sworn an oath to protect the royal household. We answer to no one else but you."

268.speaker: Titus Gordion
268.text: "Gladly. Aside from general security, the Golden Guard has had a long history of carrying out more *private* matters for the king."

269.speaker: Titus Gordion
269.text: "As in *offensive* operations, if you get my meaning."

270.speaker: Player_Romus
270.text: "He gave his life for a good cause."

271.speaker: Player_Romus
271.text: "So much senseless bloodshed. May it never happen again."

272.speaker: Titus Gordion
272.text: "That's where my military training comes in. I was selected to benefit from the highest-level instruction at Camp Domus."

273.speaker: Titus Gordion
273.text: "For what it's worth, sir, he believed in the cause. He never turned against King Valero."

274.speaker: Titus Gordion
274.text: "He believed in it with all his heart. He never turned against King Valero."

275.speaker: Player_Romus
275.text: "I'm sorry for your loss. Didn't mean to bring up bad memories."

276.speaker: Titus Gordion
276.text: "Not a problem, sir. He died fighting for what he believed in."

277.speaker: Titus Gordion
277.text: "I took up championship boxing to support us."

278.speaker: Titus Gordion
278.text: "I had a fairly normal childhood until my father was killed during the operation to take back Pales."

279.speaker: Titus Gordion
279.text: "Needless to say, his death brought about a long period of financial instability. My mother did what she could, but it wasn't enough."

281.speaker: Player_Romus
281.text: "Well, that explains your fisticuffs from earlier! You fared well, I assume?"

283.speaker: Titus Gordion
283.text: "Good enough to catch the eye of military recruiters. I do sometimes miss those days in the ring on occasion."

284.speaker: Titus Gordion
284.text: "Good enough to attract the attention of military recruiters. I do find myself longing for those days in the ring from time to time."

285.speaker: Titus Gordion
285.text: "I worked my way up through the ranks until just a few years ago, when General Taddeus Azaro approached me with the idea of reinstating the Golden Guard."

289.speaker: Player_Romus
289.text: "Yes, yes... We've been over that already. Tell me something I don't know."

290.speaker: Player_Romus
290.text: "And I am forever grateful. Please, continue."

292.speaker: Player_Romus
292.text: "Oh, I'm definitely interested in hearing more."

294.speaker: Player_Romus
294.text: "I don't like the sound of that."

295.speaker: Hugo Toras
295.text: "Outside of less scrupulous dealings, it might also pique your interest to know that they were once tasked with serving as emergency firefighters in the event of an unruly blaze."

297.speaker: Titus Gordion
297.text: "We do what we must to ensure the protection of the monarchy. And sometimes that requires us to extend beyond our typical duties."

298.speaker: Titus Gordion
298.text: "Let's just say... the public is better off not not knowing the types of operations we've handled beyond simple security."

299.speaker: Titus Gordion
299.text: "The real world isn't as black and white as it seems, which is where we come in. We navigate in the gray."

300.speaker: Narrator
300.text: Titus hesitated a moment, casting a curious glance at Hugo as he did.

301.speaker: Hugo Toras
301.text: "Alright, I'll come out and say it."

302.speaker: Hugo Toras
302.text: "Since their return, their dealing with such matters has been limited in scope, however, the potential to broaden their... *flexibility* is still there."

303.speaker: Player_Romus
303.text: "If what you're saying is true, then I am truly shocked."

304.speaker: Player_Romus
304.text: "I'd heard rumors of such clandestine actions, but this is the first time I've received official confirmation."

305.speaker: Player_Romus
305.text: "I find the notion of an organization working outside the rule of law truly worrisome."

306.speaker: Player_Romus
306.text: "Is it wrong to see great potential in sanctioning such actions?"

307.speaker: Titus Gordion
307.text: "As I said, I am at your command."

308.speaker: Titus Gordion
308.text: "We only work within the confines given to us by the king. It's a matter of defining what those parameters are."

309.speaker: Titus Gordion
309.text: "Secrecy is of the utmost importance to us."

310.speaker: Titus Gordion
310.text: "By deploying us to assist in disaster relief, the crown could demonstrate concern for the well-being of the local populace."

311.speaker: Player_Romus
311.text: "If we're relying on the Golden Guard to handle fires, we have far bigger problems on our hands."

312.speaker: Player_Romus
312.text: "You can rest assured that I won't be sending you out on any firefighting excursions."

313.speaker: Player_Romus
313.text: "Seeing as how putting out fires falls within your existing duties, extinguishing *literal* fires doesn't sound too far-fetched."

314.speaker: Player_Romus
314.text: "Well, then next time I hear of any kittens stuck in trees, I'll let you know."

317.speaker: Titus Gordion
317.text: "I'm actually allergic to cats, but I won't let that get in my way."

319.speaker: Titus Gordion
319.text: "Hopefully it won't get to that point."

321.speaker: Hugo Toras
321.text: "I think that was a very productive meeting, if I do say so myself."

322.speaker: Narrator
322.text: Before long, Hugo and I left the armory and were making our way back through the palace courtyard.

326.speaker: Player_Romus
326.text: "As do I. Strengthening ties has its benefits, as you rightly pointed out. Let's hope for continued amicability."

328.speaker: Hugo Toras
328.text: "Yes, but as your Grand Vizier, I'm obligated to give advice."

330.speaker: Hugo Toras
330.text: "I have no doubt that it will."

333.speaker: Hugo Toras
333.text: "I look forward to providing you with further guidance."

334.speaker: Player_Romus
334.text: "Watch your words. Your obligations mean little in the face of my authority."

335.speaker: Player_Romus
335.text: "Fine. But the next time you feel compelled to give unsolicited advice, you may find yourself on the receiving end of unsolicited... *feedback*, if you will."

336.speaker: Player_Romus
336.text: "You're right. Please excuse my curtness. I welcome any advice you have to give."

337.speaker: Narrator
337.text: Hugo and I said our goodbyes and parted ways.

342.speaker: Narrator
342.text: Titus was a good ally to have. Much could be gained by solidifying a strong relationship, and I looked forward to what his resources and skill sets would bring.

343.speaker: Narrator
343.text: I still wasn't fully sold on whether or not Titus could be trusted. But I was satisfied knowing that my influence over him remained strong.

346.speaker: Hugo Toras
346.text: "Such collaboration will not only elevate but bring us closer to our goals."

351.speaker: Hugo Toras
351.text: "As always, your perspective is highly valued."

354.speaker: Hugo Toras
354.text: "In my experience, a little confidence can go a long way."

356.speaker: Narrator
356.text: Titus gave a heartfelt bow and left my company.

362.speaker: Narrator
362.text: Navigating through the armory once more, I eventually found my uncle in the vicinity of Titus' boxing match.

363.speaker: Narrator
363.text: I retraced my steps through the armory, and before long, I found myself back outside crossing the courtyard.

364.speaker: Hugo Toras
364.text: "There you are! I trust your discussion with Titus was productive?"

366.speaker: Player_Romus
366.text: "Yes, very. Though I'd rather not go into detail."

367.speaker: Player_Romus
367.text: "As productive as one can be when talking to a dumb grunt."

368.speaker: Hugo Toras
368.text: "I can assure you that he's anything but dumb. He's one of the most capable people I've ever met."

371.speaker: Hugo Toras
371.text: "That said, for me to offer you the most effective counsel, I suggest providing me with such details in the future."

372.speaker: Hugo Toras
372.text: "However, moving forward, I recommend ensuring that I am kept well-informed -- seeing as how I'm your advisor."

374.speaker: Hugo Toras
374.text: "I do hope you'll one day hold him in as high regard as I do."

375.speaker: Player_Romus
375.text: "It was, actually. I seem to have misjudged the captain."

380.speaker: Hugo Toras
380.text: "I won't overstep my bounds by asking the nature of your chat. However, to provide you with optimal guidance, I propose sharing such information with me going forward."

381.speaker: Player_Romus
381.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_SecurityTitus_TitusBackground"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_SecurityTitus_GoldenGuardBackground"]  == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_SecurityTitus_HugoPresent"] == true) == false)

382.speaker: Player_Romus
382.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_SecurityTitus_TitusBackground"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_SecurityTitus_GoldenGuardBackground"]  == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_SecurityTitus_HugoPresent"] == true) == false)

383.speaker: Player_Romus
383.text: "I appreciate your thorough explanation, Titus, but try to bring it to a natural conclusion a little sooner next time."
383.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_SecurityTitus_TitusBackground"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_SecurityTitus_GoldenGuardBackground"]  == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_SecurityTitus_HugoPresent"] == true) == false)

385.speaker: Titus Gordion
385.text: "I'm glad I could provide you with further insight."

388.speaker: Narrator
388.text: I left my uncle and caught up to Captain Gordion as he stepped inside the building.

389.speaker: Narrator
389.text: Upon entering, I was once again enveloped by an array of antiquated weaponry and armor.

417.speaker: Titus Gordion
417.text: "So, I put on a pair of gloves and entered the world of championship boxing to provide for my family."

421.speaker: Narrator
421.text: Titus hesitated a moment before continuing.

422.speaker: Titus Gordion
422.text: "The Golden Guard has had a long rich history."

423.speaker: Titus Gordion
423.text: "Nevertheless the chance to fully restore our actions remains open."

427.speaker: Titus Gordion
427.text: "If there's anything else I can do for you, don't hesitate to ask."

443.speaker: Narrator
443.text: I motioned to a broadsword prominently displayed in the center of the room.

444.speaker: Narrator
444.text: I pointed to an intricately adorned armored suit that stood out amongst the others.

445.speaker: Narrator
445.text: I gestured toward a metallic, coffin-like contraption that stood upright.

447.speaker: Player_Romus
447.text: "Hard to believe it was used at all."

448.speaker: Player_Romus
448.text: "Too bad. A lot of fun could be had with that."

450.speaker: Titus Gordion
450.text: "Not often. It was more to scare people, if anything."

451.speaker: Titus Gordion
451.text: "Enhanced interrogation is serious business, Your Majesty. There are much more efficient methods in existence today."

452.speaker: Player_Romus
452.text: "I'm more interested in knowing if his armor would fit me."

454.speaker: Player_Romus
454.text: "Yes, but it's always good to refresh myself on our history."

455.speaker: Titus Gordion
455.text: "Everyone back then was much shorter, so, unfortunately, I don't believe it would, given your frame."

459.speaker: Hugo Toras
459.text: "If you really want a suit of armor that fits, I'm sure we could arrange something."

462.speaker: Player_Romus
462.text: "As long as we get a second one for you. Then we'd be a matching set."

466.speaker: Titus Gordion
466.text: "It is indeed a sore spot in our history."

469.speaker: Narrator
469.text: Equally significant was my satisfaction in recognizing that my control over him remained unwavering.

473.speaker: Titus Gordion
473.text: "This sword is said to be the very weapon that severed the head of the commanding general of the Valgos army."

477.speaker: Hugo Toras
477.text: "I'm sure His Majesty knows the history of his own house, Captain."

481.speaker: Hugo Toras
481.text: "I can think of a few people who could benefit from such... physical therapy."

485.speaker: Player_Romus
485.text: "I've been impressed by Captain Gordion's loyalty thus far."

486.speaker: Player_Romus
486.text: "I hope that today's visit will prove you right."

487.speaker: Titus Gordion
487.text: "What else can I tell you about?"

488.speaker: Titus Gordion
488.text: "What else would you like to know?"

489.speaker: Titus Gordion
489.text: "If you would like, Your Majesty, I can have the sword polished for ceremonial use."

491.speaker: Player_Romus
491.text: "Titus is all that stands between me and an assassin's bullet, and I know next to nothing about him."

492.speaker: Player_Romus
492.text: "Be honest with me, Hugo. Do you believe Gordion can be trusted?"

493.speaker: Hugo Toras
493.text: "What I know is that there has never been a more loyal subject than Captain Titus Gordion. He lives and breathes honor and devotion."

494.speaker: Hugo Toras
494.text: "As have I. And I have the feeling his expertise extends far beyond personal security."

495.speaker: Player_Romus
495.text: "That's what worries me. Fanatical devotion can be dangerous should one find themselves on its unfavorable side."

496.speaker: Player_Romus
496.text: "I'm not quite sure we're on the same page just yet. But we shall see what today brings."

497.speaker: Player_Romus
497.text: "Then I look forward to getting to know him better today."

498.speaker: Hugo Toras
498.text: "He is, without a doubt, one of the most trustworthy individuals in the entire kingdom."

500.speaker: Player_Romus
500.text: "He'd better be. I won't tolerate anything less."

503.speaker: Player_Romus
503.text: "Well, I don't have all day. Let's find a place to discuss the purpose of my visit."

504.speaker: Player_Romus
504.text: "Okay, that's enough small talk. Let's shift this conversation to a private setting."

505.speaker: Player_Romus
505.text: "Regardless, we should go. We've got plenty to talk about."

509.speaker: Titus Gordion
509.text: "If you'll come with me, I can take you somewhere more secluded."

511.speaker: Hugo Toras
511.text: "They also carried out arrests and even liquidation of individuals who posed a threat to the crown."

512.speaker: Hugo Toras
512.text: "Since the founding of the Golden Guard, long before your father reinstated them, they were known to engage in espionage."

513.speaker: Titus Gordion
513.text: "Since our founding, we've engaged in espionage, apprehensions, and eliminating threats to the crown."

514.speaker: Titus Gordion
514.text: "But in the wake of our revival, we have yet to involve ourselves in such affairs."

517.speaker: Player_Romus
517.text: "I must admit, I fear I've placed my bets on the wrong man."

518.speaker: Player_Romus
518.text: "I should ask you the same question."

519.speaker: Hugo Toras
519.text: "Humility is a sign of strength and moral character. You shouldn't be afraid to display it, Your Majesty."

520.speaker: Hugo Toras
520.text: "Then I guess we'll see where that certainty takes us."

521.speaker: Hugo Toras
521.text: "Some might say you're deflecting. But in any case, yes. Very confident."

523.speaker: Narrator
523.text: We continued watching the fight. My guy did manage to land a few hits, but in the end, Captain Gordion came out on top with a powerful punch to the jaw.

524.speaker: Player_Romus
524.text: "What do you say we double the bet?"

525.speaker: Player_Romus
525.text: "Are your knees starting to shake, Uncle?"

526.speaker: Player_Romus
526.text: "It appears my man has the upper hand."

528.speaker: Hugo Toras
528.text: "Not when the Captain has the initiative."

529.speaker: Hugo Toras
529.text: "Never. Though I can't say the same about my confidence in my man."

530.speaker: Narrator
530.text: We continued watching the fight. Hugo's fighter landed a few more hits, but Captain Gordion ultimately came out on top thanks to a swift punch to the jaw.

531.speaker: Player_Romus
531.text: "Same. I like what you've done with the place."

542.speaker: Player_Romus
542.text: "Nonsense. I can't turn down a chance to drink with my new bodyguard."

548.speaker: Player_Romus
548.text: "Why not? I can't turn down the chance to drink with my new bodyguard."

549.speaker: Player_Romus
549.text: "Do not presume to speak for me, Uncle. I shall drink if I wish."

552.speaker: Player_Romus
552.text: "Yes, thank you, Hugo. Another time, perhaps."

553.speaker: Titus Gordion
553.text: "We in the Golden Guard are trained to keep our resources sharp in any situation. Intoxicated or otherwise."

554.speaker: Titus Gordion
554.text: "But you're right to have your doubts. Forgive me, Your Majesty."

558.speaker: Titus Gordion
558.text: "This one's strong indeed. But it's mellowed out over the years."

560.speaker: Player_Romus
560.text: "Do you have eyes on me at all times? Even during... intimate moments?"

561.speaker: Player_Romus
561.text: "Is it possible, hypothetically speaking, for the Golden Guard to support the Crown in a murder investigation?"

562.speaker: Titus Gordion
562.text: "If we were granted the resources, such an investigation would not be out of the question."

564.speaker: Narrator
564.text: Hugo straightened up, suddenly more alert. Titus appeared unfazed.

569.speaker: Player_Romus
569.text: "What do you deem to be the biggest threat to my personal safety right now?"

570.speaker: Titus Gordion
570.text: "Is there anything else you'd like to know?"

571.speaker: Player_Romus
571.text: "There isn't a murder. I'm speaking purely in a speculative context."

572.speaker: Player_Romus
572.text: "I will, should the need arise. I'm still determining if there's sufficient justification for such an inquiry."

573.speaker: Titus Gordion
573.text: "Understandable. In any event, I'm here to assist you."

574.speaker: Titus Gordion
574.text: "Very well. Either way, I'm at your service."

575.speaker: Player_Romus
575.text: "Such an investigation might require conducting surveillance within Palace walls."

576.speaker: Titus Gordion
576.text: "Understood. The Guard would definitely be the best option for such a sensitive undertaking."

579.speaker: Titus Gordion
579.text: "It is our utmost aim to protect the Royal Family's security while respecting your privacy."

580.speaker: Titus Gordion
580.text: "You can expect that we'll be watching you and your family members in public, and standing guard outside any room you enter."

581.speaker: Titus Gordion
581.text: "But what you do in that room is no business of ours."

582.speaker: Narrator
582.text: Titus looked around, then turned back to me.

583.speaker: Titus Gordion
583.text: "Your government security forces seem to have a handle on the populace. But who has a handle on them?"

584.speaker: Titus Gordion
584.text: "I don't want to overstep my bounds so early into my employ. But I do believe the Azaros could pose a threat."

588.speaker: Hugo Toras
588.text: "Please don't worry His Majesty with such speculations, Captain Gordion. House Azaro and House Toras have been close allies since the War of Rizian Succession."

589.speaker: Player_Romus
589.text: "Indeed. If there's any house we should be worried about, it's the Sazons."

590.speaker: Player_Romus
590.text: "I appreciate you voicing your concerns, Titus, even if I do not share them."

591.speaker: Player_Romus
591.text: "Don't hastily dismiss the captain's suspicions, Hugo. I wouldn't be surprised if the Azaros had designs on the throne."

592.speaker: Player_Romus
592.text: "Nonsense. The Azaros have been close allies since the War of Rizian Succession."

593.speaker: Player_Romus
593.text: "I share your suspicions. If you uncover even the slightest evidence that the family is plotting against me, I want to know."

595.speaker: Player_Romus
595.text: "What about my own family? Will you protect me if Hugo tries to usurp me?"

596.speaker: Titus Gordion
596.text: "I stand corrected, then. You know better than I do."

597.speaker: Titus Gordion
597.text: "I will try to keep a close eye on them with the limited resources the Golden Guard has been given."

598.speaker: Titus Gordion
598.text: "I doubt they would try another attempt at your life. Not after how badly your kidnapping ended for them."

600.speaker: Titus Gordion
600.text: "Happy to have your ear, Your Majesty."

601.speaker: Player_Romus
601.text: "You'd better not be listening in, either."

602.speaker: Player_Romus
602.text: "Surely you must leave your post at some point."

604.speaker: Player_Romus
604.text: "And if I *want* you to watch me?"

605.speaker: Titus Gordion
605.text: "Certainly not, Your Majesty. Any other questions?"

606.speaker: Titus Gordion
606.text: "We keep a tight rotation. Asleep or awake, you will always be protected."

607.speaker: Titus Gordion
607.text: "I, uh... do you have any other questions, Your Majesty?"

620.speaker: Narrator
620.text: Hugo paused and scrutinized me for a moment.

624.speaker: Hugo Toras
624.text: "A murder investigation, Your Majesty? Is there something you'd like to tell me?"

628.speaker: Narrator
628.text: Hugo paused and scrutinized me for a second.

629.speaker: Hugo Toras
629.text: "'Intimate moments'? I wasn't aware you were seeing someone."

630.speaker: Player_Romus
630.text: "Not right now, but anything could happen."

631.speaker: Player_Romus
631.text: "Nobody you need to know about, Your Grace."

632.speaker: Player_Romus
632.text: "Even a king's got to polish the crown jewels every once in a while, you know."

633.speaker: Hugo Toras
633.text: "Any union that could result in children is of great relevance to our house, Your Majesty. I hope you exercise caution."

634.speaker: Hugo Toras
634.text: "I see. Do be mindful that any union that could result in children is of great importance to our house."

637.speaker: Player_Romus
637.text: "As I said, I was asking hypothetically."

638.speaker: Player_Romus
638.text: "I suspect Father may have died of something other than natural causes."

639.speaker: Player_Romus
639.text: "Yes. I'm on the hunt for whoever killed your sense of humor."

641.speaker: Narrator
641.text: He drew back in mild surprise.

642.speaker: Hugo Toras
642.text: "My brother was very ill. He barely recognized me during his last hours."

643.speaker: Hugo Toras
643.text: "You're free to deploy the Golden Guard however you want, of course. But there are better uses."

654.speaker: Titus Gordion
654.text: "Never in my life would I expect such an upstanding member of House Toras to turn on his own family."

656.speaker: Titus Gordion
656.text: "Is there anything else you're curious about?"

658.speaker: Player_Romus
658.text: "What year are we in? Not necessary."

660.speaker: Narrator
660.text: As the two men circled each other, we observed their careful dance before they engaged in combat.

661.speaker: Titus Gordion
661.text: "Upon the foundation of the Kingdom of Rizia, they assumed control over the entire province of Valenqiris."

662.speaker: Titus Gordion
662.text: "Lined with spikes on the inside, it was designed to inflict excruciating pain when closed."

663.speaker: Titus Gordion
663.text: "On the other hand, his son Ricardus and his nationalist associates could prove troublesome. But they're in Brenas, far out of my jurisdiction."

664.speaker: Titus Gordion
664.text: "A long time ago, yes. But it was more to do with public relations."

668.speaker: Player_Romus
668.text: "Ah, yes. You mentioned something about your boxing days. You fared well, I assume?"

669.speaker: Player_Romus
669.text: "You'll have to teach me how to fight like that sometime."

673.speaker: Titus Gordion
673.text: "Nothing you haven't already learned from the Rizian Armed Forces, I'm sure."

674.speaker: Titus Gordion
674.text: "If I do my job correctly, you'll never need to."

675.speaker: Titus Gordion
675.text: "But enough tomfoolery. I know you must be very busy."

676.speaker: Player_Romus
676.text: "Hypothetically, could it still be used today?"

678.speaker: Titus Gordion
678.text: "I don't see why not. However, much more sophisticated enhanced interrogation methods have arisen in the meantime."

679.speaker: Titus Gordion
679.text: "Are you seriously interested in obtaining a suit of armor, Your Majesty? I'm sure we could arrange something if you were."

684.speaker: Hugo Toras
684.text: "Pour me a glass as well, then. I wouldn't want to spoil the mood."

685.speaker: Player_Romus
685.text: "Such a crude sport. I prefer hunting. It allows you to keep a gentlemanly distance between you and your target."

689.speaker: Player_Romus
689.text: "So you're good at hand-to-hand combat. But my enemies will come at me with long-range rifles, not boxing gloves."

690.speaker: Titus Gordion
690.text: "I'm well trained in the art of firearms as well, Your Majesty. I was hand-recruited to benefit from the highest-level instruction at Camp Domus."

694.speaker: Titus Gordion
694.text: "But of course I will alert you immediately should I witness any suspicious behavior."

695.speaker: Player_Romus
695.text: "I feel like I've heard enough of the past for now."

697.speaker: Hugo Toras
697.text: "Indeed, you're right. However, Romus, have you noticed that the blade appears somewhat tarnished?"

704.speaker: Player_Romus
704.text: "Would the Golden Guard aid our military if a war broke out?"

706.speaker: Titus Gordion
706.text: "Certainly, Your Majesty. Some suspect that the Golden Guard's secret involvement helped your ancestor Ariana Toras' army win the War of Rizian Succession."

707.speaker: Titus Gordion
707.text: "With our current numbers, however, I fear we would not be of much use."

709.speaker: Player_Romus
709.text: "Our professional relationship requires honesty. I will tell you straight away that I don't drink."

712.speaker: Titus Gordion
712.text: "Thank you for letting me know. To be honest, I hardly drink myself -- I just keep wine around for royal visits."

714.speaker: Hugo Toras
714.text: "I didn't know you were a connoisseur, Captain. I'll have a glass."

719.speaker: Hugo Toras
719.text: "It's early, Captain. Perhaps we should all abstain."

727.speaker: Narrator
727.text: It was the first taste of alcohol I'd had in years. Savoring its bouquet, I wondered why I'd stopped.
